sources.title: OpenStreetMap geometry
sources.note: ODbL 1.0; surrounding buildings, roads, named POIs, and the spawn's nearest highway vertex retain OSM entity provenance. Core reference boundary is OSM way/1028669287. Path widths without OSM width tags are render defaults by highway class.

sources.title: Hogangnono public apartment polygon endpoint
sources.note: Core boundary, center, and 7 individual building polygons came from the public map response /api/v2/apts/e8Q5e/polygon and were checked against current aerial imagery. Used for this local research prototype; the provider does not declare an open or commercial reuse license.

sources.title: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
sources.note: Elevation data from NASA SRTM (tile response provenance); SRTM is U.S. Government public-domain data. Tilezen processing documentation and source attribution apply.

sources.title: Dataset quality
sources.note: OSM still labels this core as the 행당7 redevelopment site, so the seven completed tower footprints use the current public apartment-polygon response. No community or parking entrances are asserted.
